name: LessonPlanBuilder
tagline: Plan every minute of a lesson – then teach it with a built-in segment timer.
description: Power Apps code component (PCF) for timed lesson plans: segments on a proportional timeline, objectives with success criteria, curriculum standards coverage matrix, resource preparation, learner-group differentiation, an 8-rule plan check and a classroom teach mode.
features: Drag, keyboard and button reordering of timed segments
Objectives, success criteria and standards coverage matrix
Support / core / stretch and learner-group strategies
Teach mode countdown for the classroom screen
Edit, teach and read-only modes; undo; configurable labels
